title: Kosher Creamy German Chicken Noodles
description: A comforting and creamy German-inspired dish featuring chicken, noodles, and a hint of yellow curry paste, perfect for a sick day.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the egg noodles according to package instructions, then shock them in an ice bath to stop cooking.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and season with salt and pepper.
In a large skillet, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat and cook the chicken until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside, then add the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter to the skillet.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Stir the yellow curry paste into the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Sprinkle the flour into the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Slowly pour the chicken broth and heavy cream into the skillet, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until thickened, about 5 minutes.
Stir the cooked chicken and noodles into the skillet and cook until heated through, about 2-3 minutes.
